summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that kept `python3 main.py` from running. `main.py` imported from a nonexistent `greetings` module, so I changed it to `greeter`, and `greet` in `greeter.py` was missing a colon, so I added it. The program now runs cleanly and prints `Hello, world!`
